purpose: Commission the amended per-side maximum against the original M152 battery and a movable clean-noise population without opening holdout pixels or product outputs.

authority.historical_m152_v1_policy: m3_checker.py, m3-checker-definition.json, commission_m3.py, and out/m3-commission.json remain unchanged historical evidence

site_population.pixel_policy: consume frozen site IDs, capture IDs, normals, step_broad_dn, and sigma_temporal_dn metadata only; never decode the protected site pixels

groups.role: primary closest available morphology for the ISO 50 and ISO 100 frozen sites
pre-registered tail-morphology sensitivity arm, rescaled to each frozen site's sigma

empirical_noise.pairing: the 22 frozen input records in each ISO group are paired in artifact order as adjacent disjoint pairs; difference=(first-second)/sqrt(2)

trace_geometry.source_samples: 403 contiguous green-luma samples at native offsets -402,-400,...,402, linearly interpolated to -400,-399,...,400
trace_geometry.orientation: horizontal when abs(normal_x)>=abs(normal_y), otherwise vertical; reverse when the dominant normal component is negative
trace_geometry.allocation: fixed-seed unique rows for horizontal traces and unique columns for vertical traces; centres are sampled uniformly from positions with full support
trace_geometry.eligibility_filter: none; allocation cannot inspect trace values

empirical_noise.normalization: divide raw difference traces by the group's already-frozen pair_spatial_sigma_p50_dn, with no per-trace, per-side, or post-result centering; multiply by each site's frozen sigma_temporal_dn

exercise_gate.reason: A nonzero but side-symmetric population would leave max equal to mean and would not exercise the amended reduction.

empirical_noise.edge_fixture: a defect-free logistic edge whose broad step is the site's frozen step_broad_dn; all eleven noisy profiles form the source hull

arms.name: iso100_production_covariance_k11
arms.output: mean of all 11 noisy source profiles
arms.far_reference: site_index modulo 11; therefore included in the output mean

arms.name: iso100_disjoint_reference_k10
arms.output: mean of the 10 noisy source profiles excluding the far reference

arms.name: iso1000_production_covariance_k11
arms.output: mean of all 11 noisy source profiles

arms.name: iso1000_disjoint_reference_k10
arms.output: mean of the 10 noisy source profiles excluding the far reference

empirical_noise.scope_limit: The noise amplitude is conditioned on the frozen temporal model. These arms test the side reduction and empirical sensor-noise morphology; they do not validate that model, an output warp, or a rendered product.

reported_pooled: legacy and amended nearest-rank p99 v_e
side_max_over_mean nearest-rank median, p95, and maximum

decision_rule.clean_noise: If any pre-registered clean arm breaches median 0.01, p99 0.05, affected rate 0.01, or Wilson UCB95 0.02, return NOT_ADMITTED_COMMISSIONING_FAILED. Otherwise return SIDE_MAX_REDUCTION_COMMISSIONING_PASS.
decision_rule.product_scope: A green result is reduction-level commissioning only. M3 remains UNMEASURED_COMPARATOR_QUALIFICATION until the scorecard's common-output, input-only-warp, and M1-qualified comparator requirements exist.
decision_rule.threshold_policy: Never change a threshold in this lane after reading the result.

inert_controls: untouched non-holdout razor identity wiring null
full_battery.one_sided_ratio_assertion: amended v_e divided by legacy mean must equal 2.000 to within 1e-12
